373.question: Match List I with List II: List I (Gas) A. Oxygen B. Carbon dioxide C. Nitrogen D. Argon List II (Share of dry air) 1. 0.03% 2. 0.93% 3. 78% 4. 21%
373.explanation: Nitrogen 78%, oxygen 21%, argon 0.93% and carbon dioxide about 0.03%.

374.question: Match List I with List II: List I (Gas) A. Oxygen B. Nitrogen List II (Discovered by) 1. Daniel Rutherford 2. Joseph Priestly
374.explanation: Joseph Priestley discovered oxygen (1774); Daniel Rutherford discovered nitrogen (1772).

375.question: Match List I with List II: List I (Gas) A. Ozone B. Oxygen C. Carbon dioxide D. Nitrogen List II (Function) 1. Acts as a diluent 2. Protects from UV radiation 3. Important for living organisms 4. Absorbs heat
375.explanation: Ozone shields us from UV rays, oxygen is vital for living things, carbon dioxide absorbs heat and nitrogen dilutes oxygen.

499.question: Match List I with List II: List I (Term) A. Political party B. Election C. Pressure group List II (Definition) 1. An organized group contesting elections 2. An organization seeking to influence policy 3. A decision-making process to choose public officials
499.explanation: A political party is an organised group that contests elections, an election is the process of choosing public officials and a pressure group seeks to influence policy without contesting.

525.question: Match List I with List II: List I (Sector) A. Secondary sector B. Primary sector C. Tertiary sector List II (Description) 1. Service sector 2. Industrial sector 3. Agricultural sector
525.explanation: The primary sector is agriculture, the secondary sector industry and the tertiary sector services.

526.question: Match List I with List II: List I (Term) A. Employers B. Employees List II (Role) 1. Engaged in economic activities 2. Pay rewards for work
526.explanation: Employers pay rewards for work; employees are the people engaged in the economic activity.

527.question: Match List I with List II: List I (Age group) A. 15 to 60 years B. Below 15 years C. Above 60 years List II (Classification) 1. Workforce 2. Excluded 3. Children
527.explanation: As the textbook classifies it: people aged 15-60 form the workforce, those below 15 are children and those above 60 are excluded from the workforce.

544.question: Match List I with List II: List I (International unit) A. 1 million B. 1 billion List II (Indian equivalent) 1. 100 crore 2. 10 lakh
544.explanation: One million is 10 lakh; one billion is 100 crore.

545.question: Match List I with List II: List I (Evidence) A. Material remains (artefacts) B. Rock layers C. Human fossils List II (Field of study) 1. Geology 2. Archaeology 3. Palaeoanthropology
545.explanation: Archaeology studies material remains, geology rock layers and palaeoanthropology human fossils.
